title: Settings Configurator, Modal Vim Keybindings, Dedicated Image Viewer & Batch Agent Edits
summary: Introduces a full VS Code-style settings configurator with live preview, modal Vim keybindings with LSP motions and interactive cheat sheet, a dedicated zoom/pan image viewer with Markdown lightbox, batch inline agent editing, and live git status synchronization.

categories.name: Settings Configurator & Preferences
items: Full settings modal with category navigation, quick search filtering, and raw JSON editor
Tagged setting definitions with types, defaults, descriptions, and allowed value badges
Live preview for typography, cursor style, word wrap, and themes without requiring an editor reload
Keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+, and dedicated status bar entry point for quick configuration
Persistent settings store with schema validation, default fallbacks, and REST API endpoints

categories.name: Modal Vim Keybindings
items: Modal Vim navigation module supporting Normal and Visual modes with status bar indicator
Standard motions for cursor movement (h, j, k, l), line jumping (gg, G, :<n>), and viewport scrolling (Ctrl+U, Ctrl+D)
Forward and backward in-file search motions (/ and ?) with occurrence navigation (n, N)
Vim-style LSP shortcut motions: gd (go to definition), gr (find references), gh / K (hover documentation), and gc (call hierarchy)
Visual selection actions for code yank (y), citation reference copy, and inline agent edit invocation (Alt+E)
editor.vimMode preference toggle in settings dialog and Command Palette with interactive Vim cheat sheet modal

categories.name: Dedicated Image Viewer & Markdown Lightbox
items: Open image files (.png, .jpg, .svg, .webp, .ico, .gif) as first-class tabs with custom file icons
Interactive dedicated image viewer with zoom controls, pan navigation, and smooth vs. pixelated rendering toggle
Status bar metrics display showing image dimensions, active zoom percentage, and file size
Background contrast modes (checkerboard, dark, light) for inspecting transparent graphics and icons
Click-to-expand lightbox overlay for inline Markdown preview images with lazy loading and error fallbacks

categories.name: Batch Inline Editing & Git Synchronization
items: Multi-comment batch agent edit orchestration supporting concurrent non-overlapping inline edits across selections
Structured top-to-bottom compose box layout with document-order insertion
Live workspace refresh preserving expanded tree folders and open tabs without losing editor state
Real-time git-modified tab indicators and automatic diff gutter recomputation on clean files
Added Mod+Shift+R keyboard shortcut to manually trigger immediate workspace refresh

categories.name: Benchmarks & Multi-Editor Comparisons
items: Added passive memory and resource footprint benchmarks comparing px0 against Zed and Sublime Text
Tracked time-to-open and time-to-first-interaction metrics demonstrating px0's ultra-low resource profile
Updated benchmark comparison matrix in documentation highlighting sub-10ms startup and sub-15MB idle RAM usage

categories.name: Documentation & Fixes
items: Added comprehensive user-facing features documentation suite with 17 detailed feature guides and matrix index
Fixed top-level identifier collision in Node.js fallback bundler for clean bundle distribution
